title: Heartbeat
blurb: Two slow lub-dub heartbeats, deep enough to feel in a subwoofer. This is the oldest tension trick in audio: put a heartbeat under any clip and it instantly becomes a horror trailer. Editors use it for suspense builds, jump-scare setups, and that moment before opening exam results. Synthesized at 55 Hz for real low-end weight. Free to download and loop.
origin: Original low-frequency synthesis of a resting human heartbeat.
